_readme: The InstaWords product identity from Partner Center (partner.microsoft.com/dashboard):
Apps and games > InstaWords > Product management > Product identity.
PackageFamilyName and StoreId are for reference and checks only (CI compares the installed test copy's
family name with PackageFamilyName). Set placeholder to true only for test values such as
CN=InstaWords-Test: the build then warns that the Store would reject the package.
Name: FastKiwi.InstaWords
